definitions.gloss: disembarking from an aircraft; getting off a plane
definitions.explanation: The act of leaving an aircraft after it lands. A formal term used mainly in aviation and airport announcements, the opposite of {搭乗|とうじょう} (boarding).

examples.japanese: {降機|こうき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{後方|こうほう}→後方：19126_kouhou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{座席|ざせき}→座席：02832_zaseki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{順|じゅん}→順：03342_jun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{降機|こうき}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please disembark in order, starting from the rear seats.

examples.japanese: ⟦{乗|の}り{継|つ}ぎ→乗り継ぎ：09926_noritsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{乗客|じょうきゃく}→乗客：03284_joukyaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{降機|こうき}⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{係員|かかりいん}→係員：27111_kakariin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{案内|あんない}→案内：01291_annai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}って→従う：02059_shitagau⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Transferring passengers, please follow the staff's directions after disembarking.

notes:
A formal, written-style term heard mainly in airline and airport announcements. In everyday speech people usually say ⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{降|お}りる→降りる：00568_oriru⟧ instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {降機|こうき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to disembark
- {降機|こうき}{口|ぐち}: aircraft exit door
- {降機|こうき}⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧: at the time of disembarking

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{搭乗|とうじょう}→搭乗：06200_toujou⟧: boarding — the opposite act of getting on an aircraft.
- ⟦{下車|げしゃ}→下車：00068_gesha⟧: getting off — used for trains and buses rather than planes.
